text:
deploy-bot: Deploy started -> canary rollout 10% for model rw-infer-2026-03-17-v2 (artifact sha: abc1234def). Initiator: @julia_mlops. Targets: canary pool shard-affinity=A.

julia_mlops: seeing garbled tokenization + spike in model stderr on canary pods. Sample output:
```
Input: 'Summarize the quarterly earnings.'\nOutput: '\uFFFD\uFFFD\uFFFD net profit 0x3 \n'
```
Not fraud, looks like tokenizer mismatch / weight->vocab alignment issue. Rolling back canary? :rotating_light:

mike_mlops: grabbing the artifact manifest now. Early hint: weightset metadata claims quant=int8 but storage object tagged int4. Registry entry: weightset-id=ws-77bd mismatch with release tag rw-infer-v2.1. Investigating push logs (CI->artifacts): `./ci/publish_weights --tag rw-infer-v2.1` shows upload to wrong bucket.

eric_oncall: paging SRE. Canary error rate up 12% (5xx + malformed outputs) and latency up 30% for canary traffic. Customer reports: ACME search relevance degraded. Need live mitigation: abort rollout + route canary to stable model. Anyone with permission can flip the routing flag.

opsbot: feature-flag `routing.model.default` set -> `stable` (requested by @eric_oncall). Update succeeded. :white_check_mark:

julia_mlops: confirmed new requests routed to stable model v1.9. Canary still serving some sticky sessions, evicting canary pods now: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/infer-canary -n canary`.

support_leah: creating high-priority customer ticket for ACME, adding mitigation steps and workaround (force search to stable endpoint). Customer impact: ~2% of ACME queries affected in last 10m, they escalated to account team. Ticket: https://tickets.internal/acme/2456

mike_mlops: CI logs show a race where an old artifact alias pointed at ws-77bd after an automated promote job ran concurrently. Fixing promote job and adding a pre-publish vet check (verify weightset sha vs tokenizer-vocab-hash). Patch in flight: https://git.internal/rw/ci/merge-request/712

eric_oncall: oncall handoff: I'll stay until rollback completes, then hand off to @anna_sre for postmortem and infra follow-ups in ~30m. Quick TL;DR for incident channel: cause = mislabeled weightset + tokenizer config drift during release; mitigation = flipped routing flag -> stable, evicted canary pods, initiated rollback of canary artifacts, notified customer. :memo:

monitoring-bot: Metrics snapshot: canary error rate peaked at 14% (1768881238), request latency p95 rose from 120ms -> 160ms. KV cache hit unchanged. Link: https://dashboards.internal/canary/rollouts/1768881234

anna_sre: taking postmortem ownership after handoff. Next steps: 1) force CI promote job to be single-writer, 2) add artifact/manifest checksum gate in release pipeline, 3) add canary-encoding smoke tests (tokenizer roundtrip) before traffic ramp. Will schedule follow-up with Release Eng and ML Infra.

eric_oncall: final note before handing off: run `releasectl revert rw-infer-2026-03-17-v2 --scope canary` to ensure no leftover aliases. I ran it once, please confirm. Logs: `/var/log/releases/1768881234-revert.log`.

julia_mlops: confirmed revert completed and canary pods now stable on v1.9. Will prepare short blameless postmortem and include concrete deploy checklist changes. Thanks everyone for quick action. :heart:
